executive_scan.purpose: Current Executive Scan implementation uses 20 required questions; the 45-question target is reserved for a future expanded executive baseline.

advisory_assessment.purpose: Evidence-backed resilience diagnosis and strategy recommendation.

enterprise_assessment.purpose: Multi-stakeholder assessment with business, technology, security, risk and third-party evidence.

dynamic_question_rules: If a service is critical, expand application/data/infrastructure/cyber questions.
If required RTO or RPO is tighter than current capability, create a quantified recovery gap.
If third-party dependency is critical, ask about provider SLA, concentration, evidence and exit strategy.
If ransomware/destructive attack is in scope, expand immutable backup, isolation, identity and clean-room questions.
If cloud is in scope, ask about zone/region strategy, control-plane dependency, quotas, service dependencies and data residency.
If on-prem is in scope, ask about site, power, network, storage, hypervisor, facility and hardware dependencies.
If regulated, add applicable framework/regulatory evidence questions.
If a recovery test has never been performed, score evidence maturity separately from documented-plan maturity.
If RTO/RPO are unknown, do not infer them from technical architecture; mark business requirement as undefined and flag for BIA.
If multiple critical services share the same provider, region, facility or identity plane, generate concentration-risk questions.
